n: Hosea’s final plea: “O Israel, return to the LORD your God, for your sin has made you stumble.” The book ends not with doom but with an invitation.

f.w: return unto the LORD thy God

n: Hosea even gives them the words to say: “Take away all our sin, receive us graciously, and we will offer the fruit of our lips”—praise instead of animal sacrifice.

f.g: Come with sincere words of confession.
Praise offered in place of bulls; the Greek reads “the fruit of our lips.”

n: True repentance means turning from false securities: Assyria (political alliances), horses (military power), and idols. In God the fatherless—the helpless—find mercy.

f.w: we will not ride upon horses
in thee the fatherless findeth mercy

n: God answers: “I will heal their unfaithfulness; I will love them freely, for My anger has turned away.” Grace freely given is God’s final word in Hosea.
God will be like the dew to Israel—gentle, daily refreshment in a dry land. Israel will blossom like a lily and send down roots like the cedars of Lebanon.

f.w: I will be as the dew unto Israel

f.g: Famous for its majestic, deep-rooted cedars.

n: His shoots will spread, his beauty like an olive tree, his fragrance like Lebanon’s forests. The images of Ephraim as a withered plant are now reversed.

f.w: his beauty shall be as the olive tree

n: People will again live in his shade; they will flourish like grain and blossom like a vine, renowned like Lebanon’s wine.

f.w: they shall revive as the corn

n: Ephraim will say, “What have I to do with idols anymore?” God replies, “I answer and watch over you. I am like a green cypress; your fruit comes from Me.” Only here in scripture is God compared to a tree—the evergreen source of every good thing.

f.w: What have I to do any more with idols?
From me is thy fruit found

n: An epilogue for every reader: whoever is wise will understand these things. The Lord’s ways are right; the righteous walk in them, but rebels stumble over them. The same path leads some to life and trips up others, depending on the heart.

f.w: the ways of the LORD are right
